requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity, scan workflow, and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer to make business management easier for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB needs for efficiency and ease of management without dedicated IT staff, providing a key differentiator over competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software integration, SMB portal, and telemetry support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features for productivity, scanning, and device management are available and functional in the product; validated through user testing with SMB office managers and generalist IT.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Magellan must achieve and maintain HP's lowest business TCO for SMB color printers, with minimal intervention required from users.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs prioritize ROI and low operating costs; this is a core value proposition for Magellan.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires cost-efficient hardware design, efficient ink tank system, and optimized maintenance cycles.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Third-party TCO analysis confirms Magellan has the lowest TCO among HP business color printers for SMB segment.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box to be customer replaceable, with service center replacement as a fallback (MINK).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs with minimal IT resources; aligns with the target segment's needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Must meet warranty and serviceability requirements; requires clear documentation and user instructions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by end-users following provided instructions; verified in usability studies and meets serviceability targets.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refill
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure user-friendly operation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user error and supports sustainability by ensuring proper ink usage; important for SMBs with untrained staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatible hardware and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles are keyed and only fit the correct tank; tested with SMB users for error prevention.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated SMB portal for managing multiple printers and devices, targeting the unmanaged/lightly managed SMB segment.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the need for simple, centralized device management for SMBs without dedicated IT teams.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with printer firmware and AI manageability solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports registration, monitoring, control, and reporting for multiple devices; validated by SMB customer feedback.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Platform as a Service)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support HP's PaaS offerings for SMB customers, enabling flexible service and billing models.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP's strategic goals for PaaS acceleration and coverage, and provides value to SMBs seeking flexible solutions.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software and firmware support for PaaS integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan is compatible with HP PaaS solutions and can be deployed in PaaS environments.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support and Improved Speed for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: For PDL SKU, provide PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript) support and improved print speeds (target: 25/20 ppm, currently 25/19).
requirements.Rationale: Meets the requirements of higher-end SMBs with advanced printing needs and supports competitive differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware enhancements for speed and PDL/PS support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves specified print speeds and supports PDL/PS as verified in performance testing.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel environmental certification for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Demonstrates commitment to sustainability and meets regulatory/market demands, especially in regions where Blue Angel is recognized.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires meeting Blue Angel criteria in product design and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU passes Blue Angel certification process and is listed as certified.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure that Magellan contains at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitors (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses increasing customer and regulatory demand for sustainable products; provides a clear competitive advantage.
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain sourcing and product design must support RCP target.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and third-party verification confirm 60% RCP in final product.

requirements.Title: Minimal Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design Magellan for minimal maintenance and fewer parts to replace over its lifecycle.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces total cost of ownership and downtime for SMBs; critical for customers with limited IT support.
requirements.Dependencies: May impact hardware design and component selection.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance requirements and part replacement frequency are demonstrably lower than comparable products; validated through reliability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty – 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Provides assurance of quality and reliability, important for SMB purchasing decisions.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires reliability engineering and warranty program setup.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are included in product documentation and supported by service infrastructure.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing for Magellan printers via the HP App.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern SMB workflows and enhances ease of use for non-technical users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires HP App compatibility and network integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices using the HP App; verified by user acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement advanced telemetry features to support remote diagnostics, analytics, and device health monitoring for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support and device management for SMBs and HP service teams.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HP's telemetry infrastructure and SMB portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is captured, transmitted securely, and actionable insights are available in the SMB portal.
